description: Generates a CHORD on a simple (sine-table) waveform from a text datafile of MIDI pitches - a pure generator with NO audio input (input_arity 0). Submode 1 reads the datafile as MIDI note values, one or more per line, whitespace/newline separated; ';' comment lines verified accepted (byte-identical render with and without). FRACTIONAL MIDI values are accepted (60.5 renders - quartertone chords are legal); out-of-range values refuse per-value ('ERROR: Value 1 (200.000000) is out of range.'). Output duration is set sample-exactly by dur (2.0 -> 88200 frames, 0.7 -> 30870). Deterministic (two runs 1.2 s apart byte-identical). AMP DEFAULT DIVERGENCE (first-class): the banner claims amp's default is 1.0 ('max & default') but the flagless render peaks at 0.300 regardless of note count (verified with 2 and 3 notes) while -a1 peaks at 0.999 - the real default is 0.3; this entry pins default 0.5 and always emits -a. -a0 is accepted but renders digital silence (fails output verification). NO parameter is breakpoint-capable (amp refuses 'Cannot read parameter 5', dur 'Cannot read parameter 3'). Multichannel output is dual-mono (stereo channels verified bit-identical); chans is CDP-enforced 1-16 despite the banner's '1, 2 or 4'.
musical_use: Instant pads and test chords without a synth chain: write the voicing as MIDI numbers (fractional values for microtonal spellings), pick a duration, done. The waveform is a plain wavetable tone - clean, organ-flute-ish - so the interest is the VOICING: wide low-interval clusters beat slowly, close high clusters shimmer. Because it is deterministic and sample-exact it makes reliable tuning references and alignment stems. Feed the render onward for character: filter bank to resonate it, envel dovetail to shape it, modify radical 5 to clang it. Sibling submode 2 takes raw frequencies instead of MIDI - use that for just-intonation ratios; use this one when you think in note numbers. Keep amp at 0.3-0.6 when layering (the flagless default 0.3 is a sane mix level; -a1 is full scale).

datafile.description: REQUIRED text datafile of MIDI pitch values (one chord; all values sound together for the full duration), whitespace/newline separated; ';' comment lines allowed (verified byte-identical). Fractional MIDI accepted (60.5 = quartertone). Out-of-range values refuse per-value: 'ERROR: Value 1 (200.000000) is out of range.'. Write via write_data_file into the session's data/ dir.

srate.description: Output sample rate - range gate 16000 to 96000 ('Parameter[2] Value (11025.000000) out of range (16000.000000 to 96000.000000)'); the synth-family discrete set applies (44100/48000 verified). Positional - always emitted (default 44100).

chans.description: Output channel count, CDP-enforced 1 to 16 ('Parameter[3] Value (17.000000) out of range (1.000000 to 16.000000)'; banner claims '1, 2 or 4'). Multi-channel output is DUAL-MONO (stereo verified bit-identical channels).

dur.description: Output duration in seconds - sets the length sample-exactly (2.0 -> 88200 frames). CDP-enforced 0.04 to 7200 ('Parameter[4] Value (0.001000) out of range (0.040000 to 7200.000000)'). Breakpoint file refused (parameter 3). Required.

amp.description: Output amplitude = final peak level, CDP-enforced 0 to 1 ('Parameter[5] Value (1.500000) out of range (0.000000 to 1.000000)'). DIVERGENCE: banner says 'max & default' 1.0 but the flagless default is actually 0.3 (peak 0.300 verified at 2 and 3 notes); -a0.5 peaks at 0.4997, -a1 at 0.999. -a0 accepted but renders digital silence - curated min keeps it nonzero. Entry default 0.5, always emitted. Breakpoint file refused (parameter 5).

tabsize.description: Wavetable size, CDP-enforced 256 to 4096 ('Parameter[6] Value (100000.000000) out of range (256.000000 to 4096.000000)'); rounded to a multiple of 4. Default 4096 (banner); -t256 verified to change the render (coarser interpolation).

examples.description: C major triad, 2 seconds, mix level.
examples.expected_use: First write_data_file('cmaj.txt', '60 64 67'). No input argument; byte-identical on every render.
qcluster.txt: '58 58.5 60 61.5 63'. Fractional MIDI is legal; dual-mono stereo out.

known_issues: AMP DEFAULT IS 0.3, NOT 1.0: the banner's 'max & default' claim is wrong (flagless peak 0.300 verified at two note counts; -a1 peak 0.999). Entry always emits -a explicitly.
-a0 is accepted by CDP but renders digital silence (fails output verification) - curated nonzero minimum.
No breakpoint-capable parameters: amp and dur both refuse .brk files verbatim (parameters 5 and 3) - for evolving chords, render then envelope/filter downstream.
Datafile values refuse per-value ('Value 1 (200.000000) is out of range.') - MIDI range applies; fractional values legal.
chans 1-16 despite banner '1, 2 or 4'; multichannel is dual-mono (verified).
Deterministic: no seed, no clock dependence (runs 1.2 s apart byte-identical).
Generator entry: process() takes no input argument; graph()/batch()/sweep() refuse arity-0 entries (arity_zero_unsupported).
